findings.note: Steve Padilla is listed as voting aye on SB 1174 (2024), which bars a local government from enacting or enforcing a rule that a person must show identification to vote or submit a ballot, unless state or federal law requires it. Senate floor vote on the page's own record; the bill passed and was chaptered as Chapter 990, Statutes of 2024.
